objective: By the end of the lesson, learners will be better able to identify and correct run-on sentences and comma splices in the context of writing about a friend.
materials: - Coursebook: First Steps in Academic Writing, pp 59-61

stages.stage_aim: To retrieve compound sentence knowledge from Lesson 1 and bridge into error correction
stages.procedure: - Quick review: elicit compound sentence formula (SV, coordinator SV) and four coordinators (2 min). Ss complete Practice 10B (7 sentence completions, p. 59) as warm-up. Individual writing (4 min). Pair share (2 min).

stages.stage_aim: To diagnose baseline ability to spot and fix run-on and comma splice errors
stages.procedure: - Display 5 sentences: 2 run-ons, 2 comma splices, 1 correct. Ss mark each OK or fix it and write a correction. Individual (3 min). Pair check (2 min). Teacher notes common patterns.

stages.stage: Teach — Two Sentence Errors and Two Fixes
stages.stage_aim: To explicitly teach the definitions of run-ons and comma splices and present two correction methods
stages.procedure: - Re-display diagnostic sentences. Elicit: 'What's wrong?' Name errors: comma splice (comma only, no coordinator) and run-on (nothing between sentences). Show textbook definitions (pp. 59-60). Present two fixes: (1) Period + capital, (2) Comma + coordinator. Walk through each diagnostic item with both methods applied.

stages.stage_aim: To give structured practice identifying and fixing run-ons and comma splices
stages.procedure: - Ss complete Practice 11 (items 1-10). Step 1: mark errors with X. Step 2: correct using Method 1 or 2. Individual (7 min). Pair check (3 min). Whole-class feedback on screen. Address tricky items: 4 (run-on with trailing however), 10 (run-on with then).

stages.stage_aim: To transfer combined skills of compound sentence formation and error correction to the CA writing context
stages.procedure: - 'Now you know how to build AND fix compound sentences.' Ss write 3 original compound sentences about a friend or classmate, each using a different coordinator. Must be run-on-free. Individual (5 min). Pair swap — partner checks each sentence for errors (3 min).

stages.stage_aim: To consolidate error-correction strategies and preview the CA writing task
stages.procedure: - 'Name the two errors.' (run-ons, comma splices). 'Name the two fixes.' (period, or comma + coordinator). 'Before you write your CA paragraph, what will you check for?' Preview: 'Next lesson — we start writing the CA paragraph about your friend.'
